import pychrono.irrlicht as irr

import math

initRot = chrono.ChQuaterniond(1, 0, 0, 0)

vis_type = veh.VisualizationType_MESH

chassis_collision_type = veh.CollisionType_NONE

terrainWidth = 100.0   # size in Y direction

# Poon chassis tracked by the camera

# Contact method

contact_vis = False

# Simulation step sizes
step_size = 1e-3
tire_step_size = step_size

# Time interval between two render frames
render_step_size = 1.0 / 50  # FPS = 50

# --------------
# Create systems
# --------------

# Create the Sedan vehicle, set parameters, and initialize
vehicle = veh.BMW_E90()
vehicle.SetContactMethod(contact_method)
vehicle.SetChassisCollisionType(chassis_collision_type)
vehicle.SetChassisFixed(False)
vehicle.SetInitPosition(chrono.ChCoordsysd(initLoc, initRot))
vehicle.SetTireType(tire_model)
vehicle.SetTireStepSize(tire_step_size)


vehicle.Initialize()

vehicle.SetChassisVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetSuspensionVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetSteeringVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetWheelVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetTireVisualizationType(vis_type)

vehicle.GetSystem().SetCollisionSystemType(chrono.ChCollisionSystem.Type_BULLET)

# Create the terrain
patch_mat = chrono.ChContactMaterialNSC()
patch_mat.SetFriction(0.9)
patch_mat.SetRestitution(0.01)
terrain = veh.RigidTerrain(vehicle.GetSystem())
patch = terrain.AddPatch(patch_mat, 
    chrono.ChCoordsysd(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0), chrono.QUNIT), 
    terrainLength, terrainWidth)

patch.SetTexture(veh.GetDataFile("terrain/textures/tile4.jpg"), 200, 200)
patch.SetColor(chrono.ChColor(0.8, 0.8, 0.5))
terrain.Initialize()

# Create the vehicle Irrlicht interface

vis = veh.ChWheeledVehicleVisualSystemIrrlicht()
vis.SetWindowTitle('Sedan')
vis.SetWindowSize(1280, 1024)
vis.SetChaseCamera(trackPoint, 6.0, 0.5)
vis.Initialize()
vis.AddLogo(chrono.GetChronoDataFile('logo_pychrono_alpha.png'))
vis.AddLightDirectional()
vis.AddSkyBox()
vis.AttachVehicle(vehicle.GetVehicle())


# Create the driver system
driver = veh.ChInteractiveDriverIRR(vis)

# Set the time response for steering and throttle keyboard inputs.
steering_time = 1.0  # time to go from 0 to +1 (or from 0 to -1)
throttle_time = 1.0  # time to go from 0 to +1
braking_time = 0.3   # time to go from 0 to +1
driver.SetSteeringDelta(render_step_size / steering_time)
driver.SetThrottleDelta(render_step_size / throttle_time)
driver.SetBrakingDelta(render_step_size / braking_time)

driver.Initialize()

# ---------------
# Simulation loop
# ---------------

# output vehicle mass
print( "VEHICLE MASS: ",  vehicle.GetVehicle().GetMass())

# Number of simulation steps between miscellaneous events
render_steps = math.ceil(render_step_size / step_size)

# Initialize simulation frame counter s
realtime_timer = chrono.ChRealtimeStepTimer()
step_number = 0
render_frame = 0

while vis.Run() :
    time = vehicle.GetSystem().GetChTime()

    # Render scene and output POV-Ray data
    if (step_number % render_steps == 0) :
        vis.BeginScene()
        vis.Render()
        vis.EndScene()
        render_frame += 1

    # Get driver inputs
    driver_inputs = driver.GetInputs()

    # Update modules (process inputs from other modules)
    driver.Synchronize(time)
    terrain.Synchronize(time)
    vehicle.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs, terrain)
    vis.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs)

    # Advance simulation for one timestep for all modules
    driver.Advance(step_size)
    terrain.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle.Advance(step_size)
    vis.Advance(step_size)
    # Increment frame number
    step_number += 1

    # Spin in place for real time to catch up
    realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)

import math

initRot = chrono.ChQuaterniond(1, 0, 0, 0)

throttle_time = 1.0
braking_time = 0.3

step_size = 1e-4
render_step_size = 1.0 / 100  # FPS = 100

# Reference speed input for controlling vehicle speed
target_speed = 50.0  # max speed (m/s)
speed_error = 0.0

# PID controller parameters
kp = 2.0
ki = 0.1
kd = 0.2

# Initialize vehicle
vehicle = veh.BMW_E90()
vehicle.SetContactMethod(contact_method)
vehicle.SetChassisCollisionType(chassis_collision_type)
vehicle.SetChassisFixed(False)
vehicle.SetInitPosition(chrono.ChCoordsysd(initLoc, initRot))
vehicle.SetTireType(veh.TireModelType_RIGID)  # Changed to RIGID for better control
vehicle.SetTireStepSize(step_size)

vehicle.Initialize()

# Set visualization type for all parts

# Create the terrain as a highway mesh
terrainHeight = 0.5  # height of the highway
terrainLength = 1000.0  # size in X direction
terrainWidth = 20.0   # size in Y direction
terrainModel = veh.RigidTerrain.HighwayMesh

# Create the terrain

patch_mat.SetRestitution(0.01)

vis.SetWindowSize(1280, 1024)
vis.SetChaseCamera(trackPoint, 6.0, 0.5)
vis.Initialize()
vis.AddLogo(chrono.GetChronoDataFile('logo_pychrono_alpha.png'))
vis.AddLightDirectional()
vis.AddSkyBox()
vis.AttachVehicle(vehicle.GetVehicle())

# Create the driver system
driver = veh.ChInteractiveDriverIRR(vis)

# Set time responses for steering, throttle, and braking
driver.SetSteeringDelta(render_step_size / steering_time)
driver.SetThrottleDelta(render_step_size / throttle_time)
driver.SetBrakingDelta(render_step_size / braking_time)

# Initialize speed and PID controller variables
current_speed = 0.0
throttle_input = 0.0

driver.Initialize()

# Simulation loop
realtime_timer = chrono.ChRealtimeStepTimer()
step_number = 0
render_frame = 0

while vis.Run():
    time = vehicle.GetSystem().GetChTime()

    # Render scene every render_steps
    if (step_number % render_steps == 0):
        vis.BeginScene()
        vis.Render()
        vis.EndScene()
        render_frame += 1

    # Get driver inputs
    driver_inputs = driver.GetInputs()

    # Update modules
    driver.Synchronize(time)
    terrain.Synchronize(time)
    vehicle.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs, terrain)
    vis.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs)

    # Calculate current speed
    current_speed = vehicle.GetVehicle().GetSpeed()

    # PID controller for throttle control
    speed_error = target_speed - current_speed
    throttle_input = kp * speed_error + ki * speed_error + kd * speed_error

    # Limit throttle input between 0 and max
    if throttle_input > 1.0:
        throttle_input = 1.0
    elif throttle_input < 0.0:
        throttle_input = 0.0

    # Apply throttle and braking
    driver.SetThrottleInput(throttle_input)
    driver.SetBrakingInput(braking_time * (driver_inputs.throttle_input - 1.0))

    # Advance simulation for one timestep
    driver.Advance(step_size)
    terrain.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle.Advance(step_size)
    vis.Advance(step_size)

    # Increment frame number
    step_number += 1

    # Spin in place for real time to catch up

1. **Initial Vehicle Position**: Adjusted the initial location to (0, 0, 1) instead of (0, 0, 0.5) for better visualization.

2. **Steering Response Time**: Increased the steering response time from 1.0 second to 5.0 seconds by adjusting the delta calculation.

3. **Simulation and Render Step Sizes**: Decreased both the simulation step size (`step_size`) and render step size (`render_step_size`) to achieve finer control.

4. **Terrain Initialization**: Replaced the single patch with a highway mesh terrain model and adjusted its dimensions to 1000m x 20m.

5. **Reference Speed Input**: Added a reference speed input system to control the vehicle's speed.

6. **PID Controller Implementation**: Implemented a PID controller for throttle control based on speed error. The PID parameters (Kp, Ki, Kd) were set to provide responsive yet stable control.

7. **Tire Model**: Changed the tire model from TMEASY to RIGID for better control and simulation accuracy.

8. **Throttle and Braking Inputs**: Added proper handling for throttle and braking inputs using the PID-controlled throttle and braking deltas.

9. **Speed Limitation**: Added speed limits to ensure the vehicle doesn't exceed a maximum speed of 50 m/s.

10. **Visualization and Performance**: Adjusted rendering to occur less frequently to improve performance.

These changes should result in a more responsive and realistic vehicle simulation with improved control and terrain modeling.

vis_type = veh.VisualizationType_MESH

chassis_collision_type = veh.CollisionType_NONE

tire_model = veh.TireModelType_TMEASY

terrainHeight = 0      # terrain height

terrainWidth = 100.0   # size in Y direction

trackPoint = chrono.ChVector3d(-5.0, 0.0, 1.8)

contact_vis = False

render_step_size = 1.0 / 50  # FPS = 50

vehicle1.SetSteeringVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle1.SetWheelVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle1.SetTireVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle1.GetSystem().SetCollisionSystemType(chrono.ChCollisionSystem.Type_BULLET)

vehicle2 = veh.Truck()
vehicle2.SetContactMethod(contact_method)
vehicle2.SetChassisCollisionType(chassis_collision_type)
vehicle2.SetChassisFixed(False)
vehicle2.SetInitPosition(chrono.ChCoordsysd(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 50, 0.5), chrono.QUNIT))

vehicle2.SetTireVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_PRIMITIVES)

vis2.AddSkyBox()

driver1.SetSteeringDelta(render_step_size / steering_time)
driver1.SetThrottleDelta(render_step_size / throttle_time)
driver1.SetBrakingDelta(render_step_size / braking_time)

driver2.SetThrottleDelta(render_step_size / throttle_time)

throttle_time = 1.0  # time to go from 0 to +1

    if (step_number % render_steps == 0):
        vis1.BeginScene()
        vis1.Render()
        vis1.EndScene()
        render_frame += 1

    vis1.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs)

    terrain.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle1.Advance(step_size)
    vis1.Advance(step_size)

    terrain.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle2.Advance(step_size)
    vis2.Advance(step_size)

    realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)

    if step_number % 100 == 0:

        frequency = 0.2  # adjust frequency as needed
        amplitude = 0.2  # adjust amplitude as needed
        angle = amplitude * math.sin(current_time * frequency)
        # Apply steering input to both vehicles
        for vehicle in [vehicle1, vehicle2]:
            vehicle.SetSteeringInput(chrono.ChVector3d(angle, 0, 0))
